messages.author: 42e5316f884713d9
messages.subject: specifying version in library()
parts:
Would it not be nice if we could specify the version of a package in library?

If I use the AetherPackageLoader and do library('org.renjin.cran:evaluate') I will get the latest version (0.12-b2) which is a nice default but sometimes I want to try a specific version.

If we allowed an optional version number at the end this would be possible, e.g.

library("org.renjin.cran:evaluate:0.11-b4")

Would this be a welcome addition if I work out a patch or it there some way to do this already?

Best regards,
Per
